text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on expected local liquidation, commission selling and good Prairie growing weather. November WCE futures crush margin fell to -7.02 Tuesday from -5.79 Monday. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3722 to the U.S. dollar, fell to 82.10 yen, rose to 1.2820 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on spill over pressure except in July which will likely be higher due to tight old crop stocks.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 lower on light hedges, good growing weather met by expected scale down commercial demand.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on expected hedges.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
